verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs show one narrow retention control: securely shared data carries automatic expirations, so the user controls how long a shared copy remains accessible. Nothing documents retention settings, item or account deletion, or deletion guarantees for stored vault data. Export (data portability) and generic programmatic item management do not explicitly cover deletion. Missing for 10: documented account/vault data deletion, configurable retention policies for stored data, server-side deletion or purge guarantees, AI/agent-specific retention controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Securely share logins, secrets, credit cards, Wi-Fi codes and other sensitive data with automatic expirations.
